name: Landmark: Mount Fuji Horizon
description: The sacred peak of Mount Fuji rises in pure black silhouette before a giant flat crimson sun disc.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game landmark icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of Mount Fuji peak with snow-cap contours. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Razor-sharp vector edges, no 3D rendering, no soft lighting, no text, no watermark.
